title: Visually Exploring Boosted Tree Models
text: ggBoostedTrees requires patched build boostmtree, CRAN release. CRAN’s boostmtree 2.0.0 three defects reach figures: frozen residuals cv.flag = TRUE (exactly flag error path depends ), incorrect na.action handling, malformed dimnames vimp(joint = TRUE). fixes live fork pending upstream merge. requirement enforced rather documented: Imports floor boostmtree (>= 2.0.1), CRAN’s 2.0.0 satisfy . install defective backend fails resolve instead silently producing wrong figures. title: Visually Exploring Boosted Tree Models
text: Fit model cv.flag = TRUE, ask whether converged: cv.flag = TRUE optional error path. boostmtree records err.rate m.opt cross-validation ran, default fit error path draw gg_boost_error() say . Every figure available data well plot, tidy frame point rather implementation detail: variance smoothing parameter paths diagnose whether variance structure settled boosting stopped. always faceted free y scale, rho, phi lambda span three orders magnitude: trajectory plot one longitudinal boosting exists — whether model tracks individual subjects, just population mean:
code: library(ggBoostedTrees)  set.seed(7) sim <- boostmtree::simLong(n = 25, n.time = 4, model = 1)$data.list fit <- boostmtree::boostmtree(   x = sim$features, tm = sim$time, id = sim$id, y = sim$y,   M = 50, cv.flag = TRUE, verbose = FALSE,   control = boostmtree::boostmtree.control(seed = 7) )  # The error path, with the cross-validated optimal iteration marked. autoplot(fit) gg_dta <- gg_boost_error(fit) head(gg_dta, 3) #>   iteration     value response optimal #> 1         1 1.0118738        y   FALSE #> 2         2 1.0008788        y   FALSE #> 3         3 0.9912097        y   FALSE  # Returns a bare ggplot, so it composes with any theme or scale. autoplot(gg_dta) + ggplot2::theme_bw() autoplot(gg_boost_path(fit)) autoplot(gg_boost_trajectory(fit))

title: Boosting parameter path data object — gg_boost_path
text: boostmtree re-estimates three quantities every boosting iteration: rho, within-subject correlation; phi, variance component; lambda, P-spline smoothing parameter time-covariate interaction. paths diagnose whether variance structure settled still drifting boosting stops. Unlike error path, recorded every fit require cv.flag = TRUE. parameter absent fit dropped silently; error none requested parameters present.
